description: Check whether a Bitcoin address is valid by verifying its checksum and structure. Supports legacy Base58Check (P2PKH, P2SH) and Bech32/Bech32m SegWit and Taproot addresses, on mainnet and testnet. Does not query the blockchain or check balances. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/bitcoin-address-validator/
